SELECT AVG(category_ratio), AVG(category_count), AVG(category_count - overall_average_count)
FROM (
  SELECT category_ratio, category_count, overall_average_count
  FROM (
    SELECT category, AVG((spent - amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(amount, 0)) AS category_ratio,
           COUNT(*) AS category_count
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY category
  )
  CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT AVG(category_count) AS overall_average_count
    FROM (
      SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS category_count
      FROM budget
      GROUP BY category
    )
  )
  WHERE category_count > overall_average_count
)
